notes.title: Player Owned Teams Update
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added Player Owned Teams: You can now create and manage your own teams in World of Football. Customize your team by uploading custom jerseys, setting team colors, and naming your team. Use your customized team while playing.
- Added Jersey Settings Menu: A new menu has been added to select team jerseys.
- Introduced 2 new default player jerseys and 2 new default goalkeeper jerseys.
- Fixed an issue where moving a player to spectator while the training editor is open caused problems.
- Fixed a glitch where players would get stuck on the ground in specific positions.

UI:
- Minor UI enhancements.
- Added informative texts to various UI widgets for clarity.

Graphics:
- Updated player radar arrow colors to consistently show the opposing team in red and your own team in white.

Others:
- Improved performance of the friends interface.
- Added publisher and developer startup videos.
- Improved login screen for first-time users.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.8.0.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added a brand new stadium: Vortex Arena
- Fix throw-in goals as valid in the tab widget (even with the rule activated).
- Fix the issue where pressing Alt + Tab would cause the player to slide tackle.
- Fix stamina refilling after timeout ends following a goal score.
- Fix throw-in double touch.

UI:
- Fix the issue where the game language doesn't save if you switch to another language different from the Steam.

Graphics:
- Visual changes in the Training Center.

Others:
- Added Friends feature:
- Added a "Friends Tab" in both the main game menu and the in-game ESC menu.
- Friend status visibility, showing whether they are online, offline, playing World of Football or engaged in a different game.
- Ability to invite friends directly to your current session.
- Ability to join a friend's session from the Friend List.
- Feature to check the server and score of the match your friend is currently playing in.
- Fixed some server performance issues.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Reduced Kick Power bar time by 5%.
- Added new training equipment: Ball Respawn.
- When performing a sliding tackle, the kick power is reduced by 25%.
- Fixed throw-in freeze player in place bug.
- Fixed football launcher configuration.
- Decreased maximum ball amount to 10.
- Lowered free spectator camera speed.

UI:
- Added "MemoFeed" feature to Main Menu.
- Changed "Football Stadium" name to "Nordic Arena".
- Show equipment angle and position in Training Mode UI.

Graphics:
- Added new stadium: "Downtown Arena".
- Improvements on Nordic Arena (previously named "Football Stadium").

Others:
- Player permissions are now remotely managed
- Removed ban length for local bans 
- Added global player bans for dedicated servers.
- Added global mute feature for dedicated servers.
- Wagering Mode was temporarily disabled.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.7.3.0
notes.content:
- Optimized networking to enhance data efficiency and improve overall performance.
- In training mode, goalkeepers can now catch the ball in any area.
- Introduced a new "Mouse Curve Lock Threshold" setting.
- Increased minimum celebration duration from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.
- Enhanced and corrected the goalkeeper's deflect force mechanic.
- Resolved an issue where goalkeepers unintentionally indicated own goals after deflecting the ball.
- Introduced a Vertical Mouse Sensitivity configuration option, now with a default value of 2, adjusted from the previous setting of 4.
- Fixed an issue where a throw-in wouldn't trigger when the ball touched the player's underpart.
- Fixed inputs, which are now being saved correctly.

Graphics:
- Boosted graphical performance: Replaced volumetric clouds with animated 2D clouds.
- Adjusted shadow contrast to enhance overall visibility.

UI:
- The spectator list now updates accurately when a player joins or switches to spectator mode.
- Players in the Tab menu are now arranged based on their on-field positions.
- Refreshed the loading screen image.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.7.2.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Player attributes are now saved throughout a match for all players on the server, including spectators. This ensures that switching sessions and logging back in won't allow changes to attributes for the duration of that match. This change was implemented to prevent players from adjusting their strategies based on the evolving match situation. Key benefits of this update include:
	* Fair Play: Ensures a level playing field by keeping attribute changes consistent.
	* Strategy Integrity: Protects the integrity of each team's pre-match strategic planning.
	* Enhanced Gameplay Experience: Players can focus on in-match tactics without the distraction of external attribute changes.
	* Reduced Exploitation: Closes potential loopholes where players might seek advantages by logging out and back in.

- Player stamina values are now persistently saved for every player on the server throughout the ongoing match. If players disconnect and then log back in, their stamina will revert to the previous saved values. This also applies when switching teams and works independently from Stamina Join Mode configuration. This change ensures consistency and fairness in gameplay.

Graphics:
- The Football Stadium has received a significant upgrade with enhanced environmental details, improved graphics, and fresh texture additions.

UI:
- Added a "Restore Defaults" button to the Settings Menu
- Settings no longer needed to be manually applied when changing them.
- Various UI changes, color and contrast improvements.
- Improved chat contrast and font.
- Fixed chat interface errors.
- Fixed duplicate timeout vote interface.
- Added a new "Chargeable Button" to avoid misclicking on Stop Match.

Other:
- Fixed ban length error
- Fixed "Already in session" warning when trying to connect to a server after leaving another session.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.6.0.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added a new exciting feature, the multiplayer training editor! You are now able to create practice sessions and routines using 8 new training equipment:
  - Cone
  - Dummy
  - Rebound
  - Ball Launcher
  - Step
  - Pole
  - Volleyball Net
  - Mini Goal

Each piece of equipment has editable settings, making your training customizable and fun!

Graphics:
- Improved fans crowd to make them more dynamic, with variable excitement and occupation levels.
- Small graphical change to Football Stadium map.

UI:

notes.content:

- Introducing a new feature called Wagering Mode in Upland integration with World of Football! Players located in North and South America, will have the chance to connect their Upland accounts, purchase Match Passes and compete against each other to earn rewards in UPX. 
- Lowered the base boost speed from 20 to 10, making the  total boost range from 10 to 30 depending on Speed Attribute level.
- Fixed Futsal floor collision.
- Fixed Old School goal collision.

UI:
- Improved contrast in modal widgets.
- Several Main Menu interface cleanups and small changes.
- Switched Match Settings menu and Team Settings menu order. Escape now opens the Team menu whereas the 'M' key (default) opens the Match Settings.

UI:

Other:

- When below 50% stamina, your maximum speed is decreased linearly by 20 units/second until you reach 0% stamina.
- Fixed ghost player bug when switching maps.
- Fixed player collision bug launching another player in the air.
- Fixed stadium invisible collision so players can no longer leave the stadium.
- Fixed players being able to set their attributes above the maximum allowed.
- Fixed spectator camera mode facing the wrong direction.

Graphics:
- Changed and improved all stadiums exteriors.
- Fixed field textures half-circle.
- Added different goals models as selectable options.
- Added field patterns customizations as selectable options.
- Changed beginner mode goals models.

UI:
- Added name of dedicated servers on the Pause Menu.
- Added public logs of important game actions to the Server Settings tab.

Other:
- Fixed ban data not being saved, making it impossible to manage bans.
- Fixed removing password from dedicated servers.
- Removed Epic authentication. Steam is the default auth method and is done automatically.
